title: Split provider registry, manager, factories, config, and options
description: Apply AstrBot-inspired capability buckets to Rust module layout so registry.rs no longer owns constants, config, factories, manager, and option parsing at once.

files.change: Move provider type constants and alias lists.
Move chat, STT, TTS, embedding, and rerank config structs.
Move concrete provider factory functions by capability.
Move ProviderManager and capability trait impls.

criteria: registry.rs contains registry data structure and registration methods only.
Concrete provider factories are grouped by capability.
convergence.verification_command: cargo test -p astrbot-provider && cargo clippy -p astrbot-provider -- -D warnings

implementation_steps: Move factory functions without changing registration behavior.
Move ProviderManager after registry imports settle.
